name: fsharp-lsp
description: F# Language Server for Claude Code

hooks.command: case "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_AUTO_INSTALL:-true}" in [fF][aA][lL][sS][eE]|0|[nN][oO]|[oO][fF][fF]) ;; *) [ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-}" ] || exit 0; ([ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/node_modules/.bin/code" ] && diff -q "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" >/dev/null 2>&1) || (cd "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}" && cp "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/package.json" . && npm install --loglevel=error) || rm -f "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/package.json" ;; esac

auto_install.title: Auto-install language server
auto_install.description: Install and update the language server at session start, and let it download its own binaries the first time it runs. Turn off to skip both; the plugin then needs an install from an earlier session, and runs only a server that is already cached or on PATH.
